about.paragraph1: Technical Product Manager who moves from discovery to deployment faster than most teams move from meetings to specs.
about.paragraph2: I don't just define what to build — I research it, design it, code it, and ship it. From user interviews to live MVPs, I execute end-to-end because I don't depend on dev queues.
about.paragraph3: I've built e-commerce platforms, automated workflows, and B2B SaaS products across fintech, edtech, and marketplaces. Currently exploring AI agents and automation to eliminate bottlenecks.

productThinking.title: 0 to 1 Product Building
productThinking.description: I take ambiguous problems and turn them into launched products. From discovery to deployment, I own the full cycle.

technicalExecution.title: Design with Technical Depth
technicalExecution.description: I design solutions that are both user-friendly and technically feasible — because I understand both code and UX.

aiProductDevelopment.title: Rapid Prototyping & Validation
aiProductDevelopment.description: I build functional MVPs in weeks to test with real users, not months of spec documents and coordination.

dataDrivenDecisions.title: Business Impact Focus
dataDrivenDecisions.description: I measure success in adoption, revenue, and efficiency — not features shipped. Data informs every decision.

projectDetail.productResearchDescription: Conducted competitive analysis and user research to understand market landscape and define product positioning.
projectDetail.competitiveDifferentiationDescription: Analyzed competitors across product and go-to-market dimensions. This revealed Invoinet's unique opportunity: combining automation platform with personalized support for enterprise accounts.
projectDetail.informationArchitectureDescription: Designed website structure with 8 strategic sections to communicate positioning. Each section used specific persuasion techniques informed by competitive research.
